description: This Java test class (ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_6) contains parameterized tests for validating XML configuration files against certain conditions and rules, specifically for different versions of a module configuration in the OpenMRS platform. It tests for valid and invalid scenarios related to XML structure, presence of paths, modules, and version numbers.

classes.name: ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_6
classes.description: A JUnit test class containing parameterized tests to validate XML configuration files against a DTD, ensuring compliance for different versions and scenarios.

methods.name: validXmlConditionalResourcesWithVersion
methods.description: Tests valid XML configuration with conditional resources for a specific version, expecting the XML to be valid.

methods.name: validXmlConditionalResourcesWithLoadModules
methods.description: Tests valid XML configuration with conditional resources and load modules for a specific version, expecting validity.

methods.name: invalidXmlWhenLoadModulesPresentWithVersion
methods.description: Tests invalid XML configuration where load modules are present with a version, expecting validation to fail.

methods.name: invalidXmlWhenMissingPath
methods.description: Tests invalid XML where some resources are missing the 'path' attribute, expecting validation to fail.

methods.name: invalidXmlWhenBothVersionAndLoadModulesMissing
methods.description: Tests invalid XML missing both version and load modules, expecting failure.

methods.name: invalidXmlWhenLoadModulesMissingModuleId
methods.description: Tests invalid XML with load modules missing module IDs, expecting validation failure.

methods.name: invalidXmlWhenLoadModulesMissingVersion
methods.description: Tests invalid XML with load modules missing module versions, expecting validation failure.
